verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects is a planning and tracking tool (tables, boards, roadmaps, custom fields, workflows), not an AI coding agent runtime, so restoring an agent session to an earlier checkpoint is a category error for this product type. The mention of assigning issues to Copilot is about delegating work, not about Projects managing agent session checkpoints, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
